svg.title: Evidence provenance and change propagation for AI and Physical AI
svg.desc: Four requirements for AI and Physical AI evidence: grounding, provenance, machine-checkable constraints and change propagation, plus a fictional humanoid robot test-report withdrawal example. Based on page 25 of the original 36-page visual paper; adapted by removing slide numbering and footer while preserving explanatory diagrams.
